lines.trans: Good evening, my dear friends!

words.gram: nominative plural, masculine, used as address

lines.trans: I am Dmitry Nagiyev, this is the show 'Head Chef'.
Only one will become the head chef of our restaurant.
Our celebrity jury will choose the winner.
And your humble servant, the best host.
Stop, we have a problem with the sound!
Guys, let's reshoot everything from the beginning right now.

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: Did they not teach you how to behave during filming?
You must always turn off your phone!
Excuse me, I just forgot to turn it off.
And did you not forget your head at home?
All right, Dima, I already apologized, after all.

words.gram: first name, used to address him

words.gram: first name, used to address him

lines.trans: All the best!

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: as adjective: ведущий специалист = leading expert

examples.trans: And the best host in the whole country!

examples.text: Ну что, с ведущим уже решили?
examples.trans: So, have you decided on the host yet?

meanings.note: до вечера = until the evening; вечером = in the evening

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.
She's offended. She's always like that.

meanings.en: to choose, select; to use up completely (quotas, limits)

examples.text: В этом году все квоты выбрали.
examples.trans: This year all the quotas have been used up.
She chose the most beautiful dress.
Agreed, I will choose a movie.

meanings.en: голову оторвать = to tear someone's head off
meanings.note: an idiom for a big telling-off

examples.trans: Mum will tear my head off.

examples.text: Какая тебе опергруппа? Мне твоя мать голову оторвёт.
examples.trans: What field team? Your mother will tear my head off.

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер

examples.text: Добрый вечер, Вика. С Новым годом!
examples.trans: Good evening, Vika. Happy New Year!
The main thing is, you keep him at home.

examples.text: А Осипенко сейчас дома лежит. У него больное сердце.
examples.trans: And Osipenko is lying at home right now. He has a sick heart.

meanings.note: to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.text: В Москве вам дают деньги на дорогую одежду, а мозги не дают.
examples.trans: In Moscow they give you money for expensive clothes, but they don't give you brains.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
Members of the jury are tasting dishes.

examples.text: Молчи и слушай строгий вердикт жюри.
examples.trans: Keep quiet and listen to the jury's strict verdict.
Don't forget to wash the toilet.

examples.text: Сейчас будешь чинить трубу. И унитаз не забудь помыть.
examples.trans: Now you're going to fix the pipe. And don't forget to wash the toilet.
Turn up the volume on the television, please.

examples.text: Не дышать, я хочу слышать каждый тихий звук.
examples.trans: Do not breathe, I want to hear every quiet sound.
Our celebrity jury will choose the winner.

examples.text: Ночью мы смотрели на звёздное небо.
examples.trans: At night we looked at the starry sky.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, excuse me, there's someone here to see you.

meanings.note: перед + instrumental: to someone; за + accusative: for something

examples.text: Ну что ты, Филиппович. Я же извинился.
examples.trans: Oh, come on, Filippovich. I said sorry, didn't I?
All right, here you go. There, look.

meanings.note: лучший в мире = the best in the world

examples.text: Ты мне даёшь пятьсот рублей, а я выхожу и покупаю тебе лучшую приставку в мире.
examples.trans: You give me five hundred roubles, and I get out and buy you the best console in the world.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Нам очень дорого обходится авторская кухня.
examples.trans: Auteur cuisine costs us very dearly.

examples.text: Это все, кто выходил из отеля.
examples.trans: That is everyone who left the hotel.
What is going on here right now?
You should always switch off your phone!

examples.text: Зачем ты каждый раз отключаешь звук?
examples.trans: Why do you mute the sound every time?

отключить.gloss: to switch off, to cut off

examples.text: И позвони Цыганкову, пусть отключат свет.
examples.trans: And phone Tsygankov, have them cut the power.

meanings.en: to reshoot, retake (a scene, a photo)

examples.text: Ребята, давайте сейчас переснимем всё сначала.
examples.trans: Guys, let's reshoot everything from the start right now.
The photo came out dark, we'll have to retake it.
The name of the grand winner.

examples.text: Перед тем, как я объявлю победителя, внимание!
examples.trans: Before I announce the winner, your attention!

meanings.note: ваш покорный слуга = your humble servant (i.e. me)

examples.text: И ваш покорный слуга, лучший ведущий.
examples.trans: And your humble servant, the best host.
The horse was quiet and docile.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

meanings.note: Dining establishment. Borrowed from French 'restaurant' (from 'restaurer', to restore strength with rich broth); entered Russian in the early 19th century.

examples.trans: They called from the Italian restaurant.
In the evening they went to a restaurant.

examples.text: Кстати, звонили из итальянского ресторана. Дарят папе романтический ужин на двоих.
examples.trans: By the way, they called from the Italian restaurant. They're giving Dad a romantic dinner for two.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: слуга народа: ironic term for an official

examples.trans: He is a servant of the people.

examples.text: Всё, Нинок. Теперь у нас есть личный слуга.
examples.trans: That's it, Ninok. Now we have our own personal servant.
First they were rude and insulting over there.
Let's start everything from the beginning.

examples.text: Мы танцевали. Сначала они там грубили, оскорбляли.
examples.trans: We were dancing. First they were rude and insulting over there.

examples.text: Ты слишком сентиментальным стал. А лидер должен быть жёстким.
examples.trans: You've become too sentimental. And a leader has to be tough.
Stop, you cannot go any further!
Stop, that's a wrap! Good job, Samson!

meanings.note: Often plural: съёмки = a shoot, filming sessions.

examples.text: Меня не будет, я весь день на съёмках.
examples.trans: I won't be here, I'm at a shoot all day.

examples.text: У нас внезапно перенесли съемки на завтра.
examples.trans: Our shoot was suddenly moved to tomorrow.

examples.text: Ты же перед съёмками подписал договор!
examples.trans: You signed a contract before the filming!

meanings.note: Also a mobile phone. International compound from Greek 'tele' (far) + 'phone' (voice, sound).

examples.text: Мне нужно позвонить губернатору. Дай телефон.
examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: Учить уроки = to do one's homework.

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.note: chief cook in a professional kitchen

examples.trans: The head chef manages the entire kitchen.

examples.text: Они привели нового шеф-повара прямо из Индии.
examples.trans: They brought a new chef straight from India.

examples.text: Шеф-повар решит, подходите ли вы ресторану.
examples.trans: The head chef will decide whether you suit the restaurant.
It turned out to be a great culinary show.
Stop shouting, it turned out a great show!
Now we will arrange a fun show.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
